mainScenes.title: 01 / A customer asks to cancel a booking
mainScenes.detail: Hosted gpt-4o-mini · synthetic customer and booking · actual application screens

mainScenes.title: 02 / Original contact restored only on the customer delivery path
mainScenes.detail: The captured provider request contains a scoped PII token. The customer receives the synthetic email.

mainScenes.title: 03 / The customer confirms the exact €340 quote
mainScenes.detail: Consent alone does not issue a refund. The ledger still has zero refunds; staff review is required.

mainScenes.title: 04 / Deskhand: a reviewer sees the case and exact quote
mainScenes.detail: The review goes through the application gateway and signals the real Temporal workflow.

mainScenes.title: 05 / Approval is bound to the displayed quote digest
mainScenes.detail: The application checks the current quote again before writing to its isolated sample backend.

mainScenes.title: 06 / Cancellation and refund settle, then the application reads back
mainScenes.detail: Exactly one refund is written to the sample ledger. Success follows verified read-back.

mainScenes.title: 07 / Model calls, policy decision, review and effect share one case
mainScenes.detail: Real request IDs and correlation IDs connect the application to Auditline; no prompt values are stored.

mainScenes.title: 08 / Replay reproduces the decision from recorded evidence
mainScenes.detail: The migrated native policy retains the same refund rule and rounding; approval is a separate record.

mainScenes.title: 09 / A portable SVG receipt verifies independently
mainScenes.detail: The receipt proves the recorded calculation. It does not authenticate a reviewer by itself.

mainScenes.title: 10 / Deskhand authority: scope, tier, limits and expiry
mainScenes.detail: The seeded demonstration grant is visible. This recording does not claim production qualification.

mainScenes.title: 11 / Deskhand rules: what the application actually enforces
mainScenes.detail: Refund rules, customer consent, staff review and quote expiry remain application responsibilities.

mainScenes.title: 12 / IntentGauge results remain visible in the operator cockpit
mainScenes.detail: The live run passed 20 of 21 cases. The required policy-search tool check failed; no monetary check failed.

mainScenes.title: 13 / Health: Temporal, worker, gateway, chain and evals
mainScenes.detail: These are live checks against this isolated stack, not prerecorded status values.

mainScenes.title: 14 / Auditline: the actual run, decisions and inspection outcomes
mainScenes.detail: The gateway handled every model call with reversible PII protection and virtual-key authentication.

mainScenes.title: 15 / Request flow: inspect, decide, forward, gate, deliver, record
mainScenes.detail: Counts derive from the hash-chained log. Inspection runs before any model request is forwarded.

mainScenes.title: 16 / Sessions and context: growth without storing prompt values
mainScenes.detail: Context composition and session linkage are metadata. The original contact stays in the separate vault.

mainScenes.title: 17 / Virtual keys, allowed use cases and model/tool limits
mainScenes.detail: The trusted delivery key may restore customer text; ordinary agent keys remain tokenized.

mainScenes.title: 18 / Integrity: chain verification and the new anchor
mainScenes.detail: The end-to-end run checks its chain and creates a fresh anchor after the case and evaluations finish.

mainScenes.title: 19 / IntentGauge: fresh hosted-model evaluation, including its failure
mainScenes.detail: All 21 trials have verified Auditline request linkage. A failed check blocks the evaluation.

mainScenes.title: 20 / Inspect cases and failed assertions instead of hiding them
mainScenes.detail: Saturday opening hours were correct, but the model skipped the tool call required by this fixture.

mainScenes.title: 21 / Finished: one refund, verified read-back, honest evaluation result
mainScenes.detail: Customer data was synthetic. Hosted model calls, the three applications and all displayed evidence are real.

extraScenes.title: FEATURE LAB / Tool gates, use cases and durable token budgets
extraScenes.detail: Observe, enforce, user-origin pass, per-key tool lists, off/shadow use cases and budget exhaustion.

extraScenes.title: FEATURE LAB / API streams, context, native policies and signed evidence
extraScenes.detail: Responses and Anthropic streams, five-turn context, native receipt replay and signature verification.

extraScenes.title: FEATURE LAB / Counters come from the completed checks
extraScenes.detail: Findings, advisory signals, held tools and refusals are measured by the running proxies.

extraScenes.title: FEATURE LAB / Inspect individual scenarios and request metadata
extraScenes.detail: The request console makes the policy view and recorded outcomes visible for each synthetic scenario.
